description: This file manages theme configurations, including default, dark, and light themes, and provides functions to set, load, and initialize themes, as well as styling for UI components.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets the current theme, updates user settings, and applies CSS variables.

methods.name: setMattermostTheme
methods.description: Converts a Mattermost theme object into internal theme and applies CSS variables.

methods.name: loadTheme
methods.description: Loads theme from user settings or system preferences and applies it.

methods.name: initThemes
methods.description: Initializes theme settings and listens for system color scheme changes.

methods.name: getSelectBaseStyle
methods.description: Provides custom styles for select components.

methods.name: getActiveThemeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the currently active theme.
